Commentary.Commentary: Lusty blows from Mehidy along with his captain brought the lead to 442 and Bangladesh declared once their skipper got his 2nd test century on the last ball of the session. Can Zimbabwe hold on for a draw that will help them win only their third away Test series? Much will depend on how their openers play in the evening session. Join us for the post-Tea session in a short while!

Regarding the second innings of Bangladesh, it started off quite well for Zimbabwe when they had the hosts on the mat at 25/4, but then a partnership of 118 runs between the skipper and Mithun made sure that it killed any hopes that the visitors had.

The Bangladeshis have batted Zimbabwe out of the game. It is highly improbable that the visitors will be able to chase down this total in remaining 4 sessions. Now it is upto the host's bowlers to scalp the 10(9 if Chatara doesn't bat) wickets in the time remaining.
The very dull and drowsy post-Lunch session comes to an end with a bang! Mahmudullah reaches his 2nd century and also chooses to declare with Bangladesh's lead being 442.

Yes, he does! SECOND TEST TON FOR MAHMUDULLAH! And it has come on the final ball of the session! Full and outside off, the skipper drives it uppishly but it is in the gap, wide of cover and he comes back for the second! Takes his helmet off and does the sajda. Now, even Mehidy follows suit. And with that, come the break and the declaration. TEA ON DAY 4, ZIMBABWE NEED 443 TO WIN!

Short and outside off, Mehidy opens the face of the bat and dabs it through third man. There is an opportunity for the second but the batsmen take just one. Can the skipper get to his ton on the last ball?

Flighted on the stumps, the skipper wants to drive it again but gets an inside edge that runs to mid-wicket. Mahmudullah wants to come back for the second so that he can complete his century, but is rightfully sent back by his partner. 99 now !
Landed outside off, spinning away, Mehidy opens the face of the bat and runs it down to short third man for a quick single. 3 minutes left. 2 runs needed for Mahmudullah.
Fuller this time, the skipper gets it to the left of cover and gets a single to sweeper.
Good length ball on the stumps, Mahmudullah comes down the wicket and drives to short cover. No run.
Looped up outside leg stump, he defends it back to the bowler again.
Good length ball on the middle, Mehidy defends it into the ground.

Down the leg side, Mehidy looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pads and deflects to short fine leg, Initially the batsman wants the single and Mahmudullah responds but then Mehidy sees that short fine leg is coming quickly and sends his skipper back.
Gets the paddle out now, straight to short fine leg for a quick single. Moves to 97.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Landed around middle, spinning away, Mahmudullah backs away to the leg side and punches it through the covers for a couple.
Full and on the middle stump, Mehidy defends it back to the bowler with the full face of the bat.

Flatter and quicker outside off stump. The batsman plays it with the angle of the ball to the left of short third man. The ball doesn't have the legs to reach the boundary and the batsmen run three in the meantime.
Full and on the pads, swept to short fine leg. No run.
Edged and the keeper misses it, the ball rolls fine of third man. The batsmen pick up two. However, replays show that the ball has actually missed everything and should've been byes.
Full and on middle, Mahmudullah reverse sweeps to short third man. No run.
Full and on the pads, Mehidy pushes it long on for a single.
Same ball, same shot by Mehidy. Yawn!
Overpitched on the pads, the skipper drives to long on for another single.
Shorter delivery on the pads, Mehidy flicks it to deep square leg for one. The wicket keeper is standing away from the leg stump suggestive of the line that Williams is going to be bowling.
Similar delivery on the pads, Mahmudullah gives the strike back to Mehidy with a single to square leg.
Fuller and flighted on the pads, Mehidy takes a run to deep mid-wicket.
Quicker and flatter on the off stump, batsman lets it go through.
In between overs, there were messages for the batsmen. Probably Mahmudullah is caught between his century and Tea. Will he get there before the break?

SIX! STUPENDOUS! Mahmudullah is launching into the bowlers here! Floated, around leg, the skipper gives himself room to the leg side and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket! 200 IS UP FOR BANGLADESH and so is this 50-run stand. Taken just 46 balls. That is quick.
Full and around off, the skipper comes down the track and has a big heave, getting it through mid-wicket for a brace.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around leg, Mahmudullah comes down the track and slogs to the leg side but gets a top edge. Does not carry to long off. A run taken.

FOUR! Comes down the wicket and whacks it straight over the bowler's head. Full and on leg stump, Mahmudullah comes dancing down, makes room to free his arms and smashes it straight over Williams' head for a four.

Wide ball! The ball was way outside leg, Mehidy attempts to play the sweep but was way off the mark. The umpire has had enough and signals it a wide considering the continuous negative line from the bowler.
Length ball on the leg stump again, the batsman charges down the wicket. Two runs added to the total.
The captain drives this overpitched delivery to long off for a run.
Full and wide outside leg. The batsman works it down to deep mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Flatter and on leg stump this time, played to short mid-wicket for no run.
Wide outside leg, Mahmudullah goes for a huge swipe but misses and the ball hits his glove and balloons to short third man. One run taken.
The captain copies his mate's shot off the previous ball and drives it down to long off for a run. The lead has swelled up to 400!
Overpitched and on off stump, driven down the ground by the batsman for a single to long off.
Full toss on the pads, Mehidy plays it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a couple.
Pushes this with soft hands through the covers for a single.
Outside leg, the skipper looks to play the revere sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
FOUR! SLAUGHTERED! Full and around leg, Mahmudullah exposes all his three sticks, goes down the leg side and blasts it straight back over the bowler!
Brandon Mavuta is back on. 5-0-19-0 so far.
Outside leg stump and on a length, Mehidy attempts the reverse paddle but can't connect. The ball hits him on his forearm and drops down on the leg side.
Arm ball on the leg stump, the batsman misses it and it hits him on his thigh. Pitching outside leg and too high for an LBW.
Full and on the middle stump, Mahmudullah goes for a wild slog but mistimes it just for a single to deep fine leg.
Full and on the leg stump, the skipper wants to drive through the covers but gets a thick inside edge to short square leg. No run.
Down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to play the paddle but misses. Nearly handed it into the keeper's gloves.
Full and outside off, Mehidy runs it down to third man for a quick single. There is a direct hit at the striker's end but Mahmudullah is well in.
Overpitched again and Mehidy drives it all along the ground to long on for a single.
FOUR! Wonderful sweep shot! Full and outside off but Mehidy takes it from there and sweeps it away to fine leg for an easy boundary. Wayward bowling from Zimbabwe here.
Flatter and quicker this time from Raza, Mahmudullah pulls it away to square leg for a run.
Outside off and on a length, Mehidy reverse sweeps and picks a single to give the strike back to the captain.
Full length on middle, the batsman comes down the wicket and hits it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Full toss wide outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it away for four behind square on the off side.
Good length and outside leg again, Mahmudullah attempts the paddle sweep and gets a single to short fine leg.
Overpitched outside leg stump, Mehidy sweeps it away for one.
Similar ball but Mahmudullah moves to the leg side and pushes it through the covers for a single.
Good length but aimed at pads, Mehidy plays it to short mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside leg, Mahmudullah goes for a hoick over square leg, mistimes it and gets a single in the end.
Continues over the wicket, and at the pads, Mahmudullah plays the reverse sweep straight to short third man. No run.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler off the front foot. No run.

NOT OUT! Impact is outside off! Excellent review by Mehidy. It was floated outside off and the batsman got down to play the paddle. He missed and was hit in front of the stumps. Raza appeals, umpire Dharmasena thinks for a while and then raises his finger! Mehdiy has a long chat with his partner and then signals the 'T'. Hawk Eye saves him.
Mehidy has been given out LBW! But he has taken the review. Looks plumb though. Where was the impact?
Landed outside off, Mehidy dabs it towards third man but Hamilton Masakadza at first slip dives to his right to stop the ball.
Full and around off, Mahmudullah leans and pushes it back to the bowler once more.
Goes back and punches it towards Raza again.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside leg, Mahmudullah rocks back and flicks to deep square leg for a single.
Full and aimed at leg stump, Mehidy plays it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Again at the pads, Mehidy tries to play to the leg side but gets a leading edge that doesn't carry to the bowler.
Full and at the pads, the batsman defends watchfully back to the bowler.
Mehidy Hasan is the next batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED AROUND HIS LEGS! Wow. Turn. Massive turn. Problems for Zimbabwe. Big problems. This is pitched well outside leg and on the rough. Ariful looks to sweep but misses. But the ball just spins in quickly, goes past the bat and hits the middle stump! The pitch has started to change big time.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, Mahmudullah looks to defend but the ball bites, takes the outside edge and lobs towards point. A run taken.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.
Looks to cut but the ball stays low and goes beneath his bat! Mehidy and Taijul will be licking their lips now.
Down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a run.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Full and on the pads again, the batsman flicks to short fine. No run. It's the first maiden since 21st over of the innings!
Makes room and drives to short cover. No run.
Played toward short fine leg again. No run.
Mahmudullah defends it onto the ground on the leg side.
Similar ball on the pads, the captain can't get it away from the fielder at short fine.
Negative line from Williams, down the leg side, Mahmudullah can't connect.
Short ball on the stumps, defended off the back foot.
Flatter and on the pads this time, Ariful plays it in the gap on the leg side for a couple.
Good length ball outside off stump, Ariful plays for the spin and misses the ball.
Full and flighted outside off, Mahmudullah comes down the wicket and smashes it in the air towards long off. Just gets a single though.
Ariful Haque is the next batsman in.

OUT! Caught by Chakabva! Mithun attempts the same shot again, gets the top edge this time and it goes a mile in the air. Chakabva runs to the mid-wicket region and pouches it comfortably in his big gloves.
SIX! Huge strike from Mithun over deep mid-wicket. Flighted outside off, Mithun gets into position early and smacks it for a big one!

DRINKS BREAK. The match has gone into sleep mode. Excellent passage of play for Bangladesh. They have maintained their recovery mode, not losing any wickets since the Lunch interval. Mahmudullah and Mithun have looked totally comfortable and it looks like everyone is just waiting for the declaration. Possibly 400?
Tossed up on middle stump, the skipper comes down the track and gets it off the pad towards the bowler.
Short on leg stump, Mithun pushes it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a single.
On middle and leg, gently flicked through square leg for a quick single.
On middle and leg, helped through the leg side for a run.
Down the leg side again, out comes the sweep this time. Swept straight to short fine leg.
Full and outside leg, Mithun looks to play the reverse sweep but misses, getting hit on the pads.
Sean Williams returns.
Quicker on middle stump, the skipper cuts it late towards third man.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Mithun cuts it towards covers for a single.
Quicker delivery on middle stump, Mahmudullah cuts it towards point for a single.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Mithun drives it towards covers. The batsmen take a single. THE LEAD NOW TOUCHES 350!
Tossed up on middle stump, the skipper hits it towards mid on. The batsmen take a single.
Tossed up on off stump, the skipper plays it towards point.
Sikandar Raza is back on. 2-0-8-0 so far.
Length delivery on off stump, Mithun drives it towards covers.
Full on middle stump, Mithun defends off the back foot.

FIFTY FOR MAHMUDULLAH! Well played, captain. Steering his ship through troubled waters. Short of a length delivery outside off stump, the skipper upper cuts it towards third man. The batsmen take a single.
Landed around off, watchfully defended.
The ball has been square driven by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, Mahmudullah looks to drive but gets an inside edge which just misses the stumps. The keeper dives to his left and stops the ball.
Tossed up on leg stump, Mahmudullah flicks it towards the leg side. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Loopy delivery on off stump, the skipper drives it towards mid off.
Tossed up again on middle stump, Mithun rocks back and cuts it towards point. The batsmen take a single.

100 RUN STAND IS UP! What a recovery from 25/4. Zimbabwe were all over them like a rash but these two have exorcised control. Flighted on middle stump, the skipper drives it towards covers. The batsmen take a single.
Tossed up around middle stump, Mithun drives it towards covers. The batsmen get a single.
Full toss around leg stump, Mahmudullah flicks it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a single.
Sean Williams to bowl now. 7-1-33-0 so far.
Full outside off stump, the skipper drives it towards covers. The batsmen take a single.
Length delivery on leg stump, Mithun pulls it towards square leg. The batsmen take a single.
Length delivery on off stump, Mahmudullah cuts it towards point. The batsmen take a single.
FOUR! Short outside off stump, the skipper cuts it between point and third man for a beautiful boundary.
Short outside off stump, the skipper hops and cuts it towards point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Way wide and outside off stump, Mahmudullah easily lets it go.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Mithun drives it towards covers.
Bowls short on middle stump, Mahmudullah pulls it towards backward square leg. The batsmen take a single.
Tossed up again on leg stump, the skipper flicks it towards the leg side.
Wide outside off stump, the skipper lets it go.
Bowls down the leg side, Mahmudullah pushes it towards the leg side. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Tossed up on off stump, Mithun drives it towards covers. The batsmen take a single.
Short of a length delivery again, Mithun pulls it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a single.
Short of a length delivery, the skipper pulls it towards square leg. The batsmen take a single.
On a length outside off, the skipper flashes but misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Dropped short, pulled through backward square leg for a couple.
Outside off, steered towards third man for a single.
Donald Tiripano returns. 8-1-15-2 so far.
Loopy delivery on off stump, the skipper comes down the track and defends it off the front foot.

50 FOR MITHUN! A very good knock from him. Came in at a time when Bangladesh were in a flurry of wickets. Has played calmly under pressure. He is the most experienced player in First Class cricket in Bangladesh and has justified his selection. Who remembers his 4-ball duck in the first innings? Certainly not me. Flighted delivery on middle stump, Mithun plays the inside out drive towards mid off. The batsmen take a single.
Tossed up on middle stump, Mahmudullah pushes it towards the leg side. The batsmen take a single.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Around off, solidly defended from his crease.
100 up for Bangladesh. Length delivery on pads, Mahmudullah flicks it towards square leg. The batsmen take a single. The lead is now 318.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery outside off stump, the skipper cuts it at the last moment towards third man.
Bowls a bouncer, Mahmudullah does well to duck under it.
Full on middle stump, the skipper defends off the front foot.
Length delivery on off stump, Mithun plays it towards point. The batsmen take a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, the skipper drives it towards long off for a single.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Mithun drives it towards covers. The batsmen take a single.
Flighted delivery on off stump, the batsman drives it towards covers.
Tossed up on middle stump, Mithun pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length delivery, Mithun pulls it towards square leg. The batsmen take a single.

Full and down the leg side, tailing down, Mahmudullah misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards deep square leg. Jarvis roars an LBW shout, but it is turned down. He wants a review as well but Masakadza does not take it. Convinces his frustrated and tired bowler that it was missing leg.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Mahmudullah goes chasing at it but suddenly the ball bounces out of nowhere and he  is completely beaten on this one.
Full on off stump, the skipper dances down the track and hits it towards mid off.
Slow bouncer outside off stump, Mithun pulls it towards square leg. The batsmen take a single.
Full on middle stump, Mithun defends off the front foot.
Well outside off, easy leave.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, Mithun looks to cut but misses. The keeper fumbles and captain Masakadza asks his keeper whether there was a nick but there wasn't.
Wide outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Great Shot. Tossed up on off stump, Mithun drives it towards covers for a beautiful boundary.
BYES! Tossed up way down the leg side, Mithun looked to push it towards the leg side but does not get bat on it. The ball deflects off the keeper's pads and the batsmen pick up a couple.
Good length delivery on off stump, Mahmudullah defends off the front foot.
Short of a length delivery, Mithun pulls it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a single.
Full outside off stump, Mithun drives it towards point.
A bouncer, but down the leg side, Mithun ducks.
Full outside off stump, Mithun drives it towards the point region. The batsmen pick up a couple.

NOT OUT! Mithun is well in. Full on off stump, Mahmudullah drives it towards mid off and sets off for a single. The fielder throws a direct hit at the striker's end and it is referred upstairs. However, replays confirm that Mithun is home.
Direct hit! Is Mithun gone? Referred upstairs...
Kyle Jarvis to bowl from the other end. 8-2-19-2 so far.
GOOD STOP! Flighted delivery outside off stump, Mithun drives it towards covers. The fielder makes a great stop by saving a certain boundary.
Short and outside off, the skipper punches it towards point where Sikandar Raza misfields and concedes a single.
Outside off, Mahmudullah looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards cover.
Loopy delivery on leg stump, the batsman hits it towards mid on. The batsmen take a single.
Flighted delivery on leg stump, Mithun pushes it towards the leg side.
Runs straightaway after the break. Tossed up outside off stump, Mahmudullah plays it towards point. The batsmen take a single.

Welcome back for the second session. This match is slowly going out of Zimbabwe's grasp. Early wickets after Lunch will be the key. The players are out in the middle. Brandon Mavuta to start off proceedings to the Bangladesh skipper.
... DAY 4, SESSION 2 ...

The Zimbabwe seamers swung the ball really well and kept the lid on run scoring. But once the swing disappeared and the ball got a bit old, Mithun and Mahmudullah negotiated the spinners and never let them settle. Runs started to flow towards the end of the session and the lead has swelled up to 296 already. The captain might look to play another hour or so before considering a declaration so that he can give his bowlers enough time to bowl out Zimbabwe in the second innings.  Do join us for the post-Lunch session in a while!

An exciting session of cricket where both teams had their moments! Bangladesh started off poorly this morning by losing 4 wickets very cheaply, but were already so ahead in the game that it did not affect their position much.
Full on middle stump, Mahmudullah defends off the front foot towards mid-wicket. LUNCH ON DAY 4, BANGLADESH LEAD BY 296!
Bowls full on the pads, the batsman gets an inside edge off his pads towards the leg side. The batsmen take a single.
Full on middle stump, Mahmudullah plays it straight back towards the bowler.
Down the leg side, angling in, the skipper just gently tucks it towards fine leg for a couple.

FOUR! That is a beautiful way to bring up the 50-run stand. Full outside off stump, Mahmudullah drives it towards covers for a boundary. It has been a very good resurrection after the fall of wickets upfront.
Good length delivery coming into the batsman, Mahmudullah manages to defend off the back foot.
Tossed up again on middle stump, Mithun drives it towards mid on.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Mahmudullah drives it towards mid off. The batsmen take a single.
Tossed up on middle stump, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Loopy delivery on off stump, Mahmudullah cuts it towards point.
Flighted delivery on off stump, the batsman drives it towards mid off. The batsmen take a single.
Tossed up on middle stump, Mithun pushes it towards short leg where the fielder is taken by surprise. The batsmen pick up a couple. The ball goes towards the leg side.
Short and wide outside off stump, Mahmudullah cuts it towards third man. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Good length delivery on middle stump, the batsman defends off the back foot.
Yorker outside off stump, the batsman digs it out and plays it off the front foot.
Full outside off stump, the batsman drives it towards covers.
On a good length on middle stump, Mahmudullah defends off the back foot.
Outside off, a tap and run to the off side for a quick single.
Kyle Jarvis returns. 6-2-9-2 were his first spell figures.
OUTSIDE EDGE NOW! Tossed up outside off stump, Mahmudullah plays for the drive but gets an outside edge past slip. The batsmen get three runs.

INSIDE EDGE, BUT NO SHORT LEG! Bizarre captaincy. With the pitch turning so much, you need to have close-in fielders. Full and around middle, Mithun looks to defend but the ball bounces, takes the inside edge, hits the pads and lobs, but there is no one at short leg to take that.
On middle, pushed towards long on for a run.
EXPLOSION! Bowls short outside off stump, the batsman lets it go. The keeper fails to collect and it runs behind him. The batsmen take a single.
Full on middle, pushed towards the leg side.
Full toss on off stump, Mahmudullah plays it towards covers.
Sikandar Raza is going to come on.
Yorker on off stump, Mithun does to well to dig it out.
Bowls on a good length on off stump, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Short delivery outside off stump, the batsman cuts it towards covers.
Good length delivery on off stump, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Wide outside off stump, Mithun lets it go.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Mithun defends it towards short cover off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. 12 from the over!
SIX! Up and over! Flighted delivery on middle stump, Mahmudullah dances down the track and hits it straight down the ground for a beautiful biggie! Clearly the plan is to unsettle the spinner.
Full and outside off, pushed towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Fifty up for Bangladesh. Bowled short, Mithun pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Down the leg side, Mithun misses his flick.
Tossed up on middle stump, Mahmudullah pushes it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a single.
Length delivery on middle stump, Mithun defends off the back foot.
Length delivery again on off stump, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Good length delivery on off stump, the batsman watchfully defends.
Good length delivery on off stump, Mithun blocks it well.
Short and wide outside off, flayed through point for a run.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Mahmudullah plays it off the back foot.
Full and down the leg side, flicked straight to square leg.
Tossed up on off stump, the batsman gets a thick edge towards first slip. It fell short of the fielder.
Bowls way down the leg side, Mithun lets it go.
Full and around middle and leg, MM looks to drive but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat back to the bowler.
Landed outside off, turn and extra bounce, Mithun pats it carefully, past first slip for a couple.
Flighted delivery on leg stump, Mahmudullah plays it towards mid on. The batsmen take a single.
Again wide outside off stump, Mahmudullah cuts it towards covers. The batsmen take a single.
Short and wide outside off, cut hard to sweeper cover for a single.
Good length delivery on off stump, Mithun defends off the back foot.
Bowls wide outside off stump, the batsman tried to fend at it but misses it completely.
Again on a good length on middle stump, Mithun pushes it towards the leg side.
Good length ball coming into the batsman, Mithun gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fired down the leg side, Mithun lets it go and the keeper fumbles, conceding a bye.

MISCUE, BUT SAFE! Full and outside off, Mithun dances down the track and looks to go over the top but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Mid off thinks he has a chance but the ball just sails over and drops down. Two runs taken.
Quicker one, outside off, MM looks to cut but misses.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around leg, blocked back to the bowler.
JUST WIDE! Shorter on leg stump, Mithun pushes it towards fine leg. The fielder at leg gully dived to his left but it fell just short. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Length delivery again on off stump, the batsman pushes it towards covers.
Length delivery on middle stump, the batsman defends off the back foot.
Short delivery, Mahumudullah gets it of the inner half and defends off the back foot.
Again wide outside off stump, the batsman offers no shot.
Bowls wide outside off stump, the batsman lets it go.
Wide outside off stump, Mahmudullah plays away from the body and drives it towards covers. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Oohhh... this one grips and turns, Mithun looks to play inside the line but gets beaten.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Mithun rocks back and punches it through point for a boundary!
Tossed up on off stump, Mithun comes forward and blocks.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on off stump, the batsman blocks it well.
Tossed up on middle stump, Mithun defends off the front foot.
Outside off again, played through point for a single. Zimbabwe getting another good over. Interestingly, all the wickets have gone to seamers so far. Will they miss Chatara?
Outside off again, pushed towards point.
Full and outside off, driven sweetly through the covers for a couple.
Outside off, on a length, Mithun looks to defend but gets a bit of a bottom edge.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Skipper Mahmudullah walks in next at number 6, replacing Rahim.

OUT! Caught! Rahim falls too! Good start for Zimbabwe after Drinks break.  Short of a length delivery on middle stump, Rahim tries to pull it over mid-wicket but finds Mavuta there. Rahim watches his bat as he regrets about playing that shot. Massive wicket for Zimbabwe. The hosts are effectively 243/4.

Drinks break! This has been an exciting morning session. Though the visitors are well behind in the context of the game, they have done well to come all guns firing this morning. Jarvis has been exceptional, bowling 6 overs on a trot. He swung the ball both ways and got a couple of wickets. What has been more interesting is the shot selection from the Bangladeshi batsmen which hasn't been particularly up to the mark. Rahim and Mithun have some work to do.
Fuller this time. The batsman comes down the wicket and looks to play the drive but gets an inside edge towards short mid-wicket. No run.
FOUR! Mithun predetermines the length of the ball, goes down and plays the paddle sweep. Gets a good connection and the ball rolls all along the ground to the fine leg boundary.
Flatter and quicker at the pads, Mushfiqur plays it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter ball on off stump, Rahim defends watchfully off the back foot.
On middle and off, bunted back to the bowler.
Full and around middle, Rahim looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards point.

Good ball again. The ball is on off and middle and jags in slightly after landing. Mithun plays down the wrong line and gets rapped on the pads. But the ball is a bit too high for it to be given out. Only Jarvis appeals.
Good length ball just outside off, Mithun defends it on the front foot towards cover.
Short and outside off stump, Mithun defends it watchfully to gully.
Fuller length outside off, Mithun leaves it alone.

Good movement here! The ball lands on a good length and on off stump and comes in slightly after landing. Rahim manages to get bat on it and play it to mid-wicket for a single. Lucky not to get hit on the pads as he was plumb in front. Appeal from the bowler but the umpire says No.
Good length ball outside off, Rahim lets it go through to the keeper.
Short of a length and quicker again, Mithun gets hit on the thigh pad as he attempts to flick it away.
Shorter and quicker ball, Mithun stays back this time and defends off the back foot.
Good length ball at middle, Mithun comes down the wicket and defends to short fine leg.
Fuller and flighted at leg stump, Mithun defends it watchfully.
Flatter and quicker at the pads this time, Mithun defends off the back foot this time.
Loopy delivery at the pads. Mithun defends it into the ground.
Overpitched this time but no run. Rahim drives it well but straight to mid off.
Just short of a good length and on off stump this time, Rahim defends with a straight bat.
Wonderful shot! Full and outside off, Mithun comes onto the front foot and plays a beautiful cover drive. Long chase for Raza at mid off as the batsmen pick up three.
Full and outside off, Mithun looks to defend, but the ball stays low, takes the outside edge and drops short of second slip.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Attempts the same shot again, but misses the ball this time. The ball turns a bit more and hits him on the forearm and drops down on the pitch. No run.

FOUR! Swept from outside the off stump to square leg for a boundary. The ball was flighted and outside off, Rahim goes down on one knee and takes it from there and sweeps it to the leg side boundary for four runs.
Edged but safe! Good ball on off stump and turns slightly. Mithun wants to defend it but gets a thick edge that runs all along the ground towards third man. Picks up his first run in Test cricket.
Loopy delivery this time, Mithun watches as the ball grips and turns away.
Flatter and quicker outside off, Mithun attempts the cut but the ball was not short enough to play that shot. Misses it completely.
Flighted and on off stump, Mithun plays it straight back to the bowler.
Sean Williams comes into the attack early.
Similar delivery but there is no movement this time. Rahim watches as it goes through to the keeper.

What a ball! Jarvis is moving the ball both ways here. Rahim leaves a length ball which comes in after landing and goes just above the off stump. Ooohs and aahs from the Zimbabwe fielders behind the stumps.
Really good bowling here from Jarvis! Just outside off and on a good length, Rahim wants to play at it but pulls his bat away at the final moment.
Length ball on middle, Mushfiq defends it watchfully off the back foot.
Good ball outside off but Rahim just shoulders his arms to it and lets it go through.
Good length ball aimed at the stumps, Rahim defends it with a straight bat.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
He is on fire! What a jaffa from Tiripano. He pitches it on a length, outside off, Rahim looks to defend but the ball moves away and beats the outside edge.
Mushfiqur Rahim comes in at number 5, replacing Mominul.

OUT! Caught by Chakabva! What a start for Zimbabwe this morning! The pacers are making the ball talk. A good length ball again just outside off, Mominul can't resist going for the cut shot off the back foot. But he is too close to the ball and it takes the outside edge and goes to Chakabva at a good height. Bangladesh are putting themselves under pressure here. Very poor shot selection this morning. Overall, their position reads 228/3.
Outside off and fuller this time, left alone by Mominul.
Length ball outside off, Mominul wants to guide it in the gap between slip and gully, but only manages to get an under edge that goes on a bounce to third slip.
Good length ball right on top of off stump, Mominul defends it to short cover watchfully.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended. What an over - a run and 2 wickets from it.

Predicto Praky - I reckon Bangladesh will get bowled out for 50. @Predicto Praky - Wow. Does that mean the commentators and players will get a day off? Let's see. Superb start from Zimbabwe and Jarvis.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.

An LBW appeal now. Full and swinging in, Mithun looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Jarvis appeals but the umpire stays calm. Going down leg perhaps. Ultra Edge detects an inside edge too.
Mohammad Mithun walks in next, at number 4, replacing Das.

OUT! Make that 2 in the over! Both openers dismissed in a matter of 2 balls. Jarvis is on fire. Best view for a fast bowler. Kyle pitches this on a length, just around off and Das gets across to defend. But at the last moment, the ball moves away, beats the outside edge and hits the top of off stump! Early trouble for Bangladesh. They are effectively 228/2.
Short and wide outside off, punched through point for a single.
Mominul Haque walks in at number 3, replacing Kayes.

OUT! Caught by Mavuta! Waste of a wicket by Kayes! An early wicket would lift the spirit of the Zimbabweans. The ball was short and wide outside off, Kayes went after it and cuts it in the air and finds the man positioned at deep point perfectly.  Good catch by Mavuta! Kayes will be kicking himself, it was a good opportunity to get some good runs under his belt as there wasn't much pressure on him. Jarvis is pumped up!
Length delivery on middle stump, Liton plays it towards mid-wicket.
Full on off stump, the batsman goes for the cover drive but gets it of the inner half of the bat towards mid on.
Good length on middle stump, Das defends off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. They pick up a single.
Outside off, on a length, pushed towards point.
On a good length on middle stump, Das comes on the front foot and plays it towards point. The batsmen take a single.
Short of a length and just outside off, Kayes ducks and lets it go through to the keeper.
Played and missed! Wide outside off and full, Kayes goes for an expansive drive and misses the ball completely.
Good length and at the middle stump this time, Kayes is on the front foot and plays it to mid-wicket. No run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around off, fuller length this time, watchfully pushed back.
Good short ball! Pitched around leg, Kayes tries to defend but there is extra bounce on that. However, he manages to fend it out.
Liton is playing away from his body this morning. The ball is on length and well away from the off stump but the batsman goes chasing it but fails to connect.
This ball is full and outside off stump, Kayes drives it on the front foot towards cover and picks up a run.
Similar ball again but this time well played by Liton, he guides it to third man who is quite square for a single.
Good ball! Just short of length, moves away from Liton after landing. He feels for the ball and is lucky not to get an outside edge.
Length delivery again just outside off, Kayes tries to defend to cover but gets the inside edge and the ball rolls towards square leg and picks up a single.
Good length ball just outside off first up, Kayes defends it watchfully off the back foot.
Donald Tiripano to share the new ball from the Media End.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.

LEADING EDGE NOW! Safe again! Das is playing with his luck. Full and around middle, swinging in late, Liton looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It flies behind, but lands short of a diving Brendan Taylor at second slip!
Another short and wide ball outside off, Liton reaches out to cut but misses.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Wide outside off, left alone.
IN THE AIR... JUST WIDE! Full and outside off, Das leans and drives it uppishly, wide from his body. Luckily for him, the ball goes in the gap but wide of mid off. Two runs taken.
